name: What specific services are included in a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What specific services are included in a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen remodels involve custom cabinetry, cabinet replacement, countertop installation, and backsplash installation. Blue Lake Construction also handles layout redesigns, kitchen expansions, open-concept conversions, island installations, and pantry additions. In addition to aesthetic finishes, projects include sink and faucet replacements, appliance installations, flooring replacement, under-cabinet lighting, and necessary electrical and plumbing updates. Because full residential general contracting is provided, kitchen projects can remain standalone or integrate seamlessly into broader main-floor and whole-house renovations.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen remodel covers layout redesigns, custom cabinetry, countertops, tile backsplashes, kitchen islands, flooring, lighting, appliance installation, and plumbing and electrical updates.
